## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the output-token ceiling of a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) — provenance for whether an output may have been truncated.

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the model's context window (that is [`gmeow:modelContextWindow`](gmeow-modelContextWindow.md) on the card, a model capability, not a per-call setting).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:samplingMaxTokens`](gmeow-samplingMaxTokens.md) as a positive integer on the [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) alongside the other sampling parameters.

### Examples

- ex:inv1 [`gmeow:samplingMaxTokens`](gmeow-samplingMaxTokens.md) 4096.
